candidats.description: A heap of sharp sand used in construction for concrete production, block making, and plastering. Sharp sand is valued for its coarse texture, strength, and ability to bind effectively with cement, making it essential for structural building work. This material is commonly used in residential and commercial construction.

candidats.description: Work to reopen Beach Drive at Beach One at Wasaga Beach, Ontario to cars in November, 2022 by removing sand piled on the road to extend the narrowed beach due to high water levels during the previous two years. Also seen is demolition of a block of storefronts which were originally the attached retail (including Wasaga's first McDonald's) of the closed waterslide previously located on the site.

candidats.titre: File:Arbeiders werken aan de bouw van de nieuwe Leuvesluis bij de Blaak met op de voorgrond de Leuvehaven en op de achtergrond de Sint-Laurenskerk in de steigers 1949.jpg
candidats.description: Building site in the construction of the Leuvesluis, seen in the direction of the Blaak. Construction workers between braid work and sheet piling with wheelbarrows sand. In the foreground De Leuvehaven, near the Wijnhaven. In the background the ruin of the Laurenskerk, with the tower in the scaffolding. Year: 1949.
